description: Would a person using the app see a different design after this change? Hint line at intake and at the post-research gate; may only raise an autonomy level.
instructions: Would a person using the app see a different design after this change: something drawn differently, worded differently, animated differently, or a different way to get around? A change only to when or how often an existing screen state appears (delays, timeouts, retries, refresh intervals, how long something stays connected or cached, thresholds), to a default value, to a wrong value the design already shows, or to speed, battery or reliability is not a different design.

criteria.true: Something is drawn, worded, animated or navigated differently: layout, sizes, colours, icons, order, a new or removed control or setting, on-screen or VoiceOver wording, animation, haptics, gestures, navigation or sheets
criteria.false: The same screens with the same look, words and motion; only timing, frequency, thresholds, defaults, corrected values, performance, reliability, tests, tooling or docs change

output: Hint line at intake and at the post-research gate. p>=0.6 says the change is visible: send it to the Designer; it may raise L0 to L1. A no or the band says nothing, and a no never skips the Designer or lowers a level.
evidence: contracts/jev/derived/measurements.md, decision-gate corpus 2026-11-02: plan AUC 0.994 (p>=0.6 correct 50/50), request AUC 0.925 (p>=0.6 correct 44/45)
